methods.formula: Market size = Total UAE infrastructure spending * % allocated to climate adaptation * % for flood resilience
variables: Total infrastructure spending (from government budgets), climate adaptation share (from policy documents), flood resilience share (from project data)
preferred_sources: UAE Ministry of Finance, Dubai Municipality, Abu Dhabi Department of Municipalities and Transport, World Bank data
search_queries: flood resilience share of infrastructure spending
known_limitations: May overestimate if adaptation budgets are not explicitly defined; data may be aggregated.

methods.formula: Market size = Sum of (project budget * probability of award) for all known flood resilience projects
variables: List of projects, budgets, and likelihood of proceeding
preferred_sources: Tender portals, project databases (MEED, Zawya), government announcements
search_queries: Abu Dhabi flood protection project list
known_limitations: Requires comprehensive project list; may miss smaller projects.

methods.formula: Market size = Number of at-risk buildings/areas * adoption rate * average system cost
variables: Number of at-risk properties (from flood maps), adoption rate (based on policy mandates), average cost per system
preferred_sources: UAE flood risk maps, building codes, insurance data, supplier price lists
known_limitations: Adoption rate is uncertain; cost varies widely by technology.

methods.formula: Market size = (Cost of flood damage avoided) * (willingness to pay) + (insurance premium reductions) + (regulatory fines avoided)
variables: Historical flood damage costs, insurance premium data, regulatory penalty amounts
preferred_sources: Insurance industry reports, government damage assessments, regulatory documents
known_limitations: Requires assumptions on willingness to pay; data may be scarce.

methods.formula: Market size = Sum of revenues of key suppliers in UAE flood resilience market
variables: Revenue data of local and international suppliers (e.g., Veolia, Siemens, local firms)
preferred_sources: Company annual reports, industry association reports, market research
known_limitations: May undercount new entrants; revenue data may not be segmented.
